# typr

The goal of `typr` is to render Typst documents from R. By default, it
will try to use the Typst CLI. If the Typst CLI is not installed, it
will try to use Quarto, which bundles Typst.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `typr` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/christopherkenny/typr) with:

``` r

# install.packages('pak')
pak::pak('christopherkenny/typr')
```

## Example

The following example shows how to use `typr` to render a Typst
document. It can take a path to a file or lines to use. Below, I pass
lines to compile:

``` r

library(typr)

doc <- c(
  '#set page(height: auto, width: auto)',
  '= Example Doc',
  'Some text'
)

typr_compile(doc, output_format = 'png')
#> C:/Users/chris/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmpeow7sK/filea881b5c2983.png
```

![Example image generated by the above
code](reference/figures/example.png)

Example image generated by the above code

# Package index

## All functions

- [`has_any_typst()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/find_typst.md)
  [`has_typst_cli()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/find_typst.md)
  [`has_quarto_typst()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/find_typst.md)
  [`has_quarto_cli()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/find_typst.md)
  [`typr_has_typst()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/find_typst.md)
  [`typr_has_quarto()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/find_typst.md)
  [`typr_has_quarto_typst()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/find_typst.md)
  : Find if Typst is available
- [`typr_compile()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_compile.md)
  : Compile a Typst document
- [`typr_completions()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_completions.md)
  : Retrieve shell completions
- [`typr_fonts()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_fonts.md)
  : List Available Typst Fonts
- [`typr_help()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_help.md)
  : Get Help Information for a Typst command
- [`typr_info()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_info.md)
  : Display Typst Debugging Information
- [`typr_init()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_init.md)
  : Create a project from a template
- [`typr_query()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_query.md)
  : Query within a Typst file
- [`typr_version()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_version.md)
  : Get installed Typst version
- [`typr_watch()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_watch.md)
  [`typr_watch_stop()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_watch.md)
  : Watch a Typst document
- [`typr_which_typst()`](http://christophertkenny.com/typr/reference/typr_which_typst.md)
  : Identify Install Typst to Use
